data.description: As a full-round action, a Vetala can possess a Large or smaller corpse just as it can a living body. The Vetala's consciousness leaves its body and takes control of the corpse, animating it as either a skeleton or zombie (depending on its state of decay). The Vetala can remain in control of a corpse indefinitely, and can communicate through the body, but cannot use any of its other special abilities.
data.name: Possess Corpse
